newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Nov 7.
newsitem.headline: PHILIPPINE STOCKS - factors to watch - Nov 7.

text.p: Following are some of the main factors likely to affect Philippine stocks on Thursday:
* On Wednesday, the Dow Jones rose 96.53 points to 6,177.71. PLDT's ADR rose by $0 5/8 to $59 3/4.
* The peso closed on Wednesday at 26.249 to a U.S. dollar from 26.255
* The Philippine Stock Exchange index closed at 2,998.43, up 11.25.
* The Philippine interbank call loan rate was up at 14 pct from 12.28125 pct.
* The BusinessWorld says Socioeconomic Planning Minister Cielito Habito warned that average inflation rate for 1996 could shoot up to 10-11 percent if a 45 peso wage hike takes effect.
* The Inquirer says Jollibee Food Corp has put up a joint venture with banker Edgardo Espiritu to step up the fastfood giant's expansion in the United States.
* The Philippine Star says National Telecommunications Co said PLDT and Bayan Telecommunications Holdings continue to meet their telephone line targets as of the third quarter of 1996.
* The Manila Bulletin says the country's export receipts hit $14.926 billion for the first nine months this year, a 16.6 percent from $12.802 billion exports registered in the same period last year.
